pick.headline: Uruguay returns to civilian rule
pick.summary: On 1 March 1985 Julio Maria Sanguinetti was inaugurated as president of Uruguay, ending twelve years of military rule.
pick.significance: Uruguay joined Argentina and Brazil in the wave of transitions from military dictatorship in South America.

alternates.headline: Shooting at Sarajevo wedding sparks barricades
alternates.summary: On 1 March 1992, the last day of Bosnia's independence referendum, a gunman fired on a Serb wedding procession in Sarajevo, killing the groom's father; barricades went up across the city.
alternates.significance: The incident is often cited as the opening of the Bosnian war, which began in earnest in April.
